font_heading.label: Heading font
font_heading.info: Used for section, hero and product headings

font_body.label: Body font
font_body.info: Used for body text, buttons and navigation

header_transparent_home.label: Transparent header on home page
header_transparent_home.info: The header becomes transparent on the home page

show_language_selector.label: Language selector
show_language_selector.info: Requires Shopify Markets to be configured

show_currency_selector.label: Currency selector
show_currency_selector.info: Requires Shopify Markets to be configured

show_market_banner.label: Market switch banner
show_market_banner.info: Shows a banner when the detected market differs

cart_type.label: Cart type
cart_type.info: The drawer opens a side panel without leaving the page

custom_css.label: Custom CSS
custom_css.info: Applied on every page. Use with care.

theme_density.label: Density
theme_density.info: Adjusts every spacing value in the theme

enable_animations.label: Enable animations
enable_animations.info: Always disabled for visitors who request reduced motion

price_show_currency_code.label: Show currency code
price_show_currency_code.info: Shows EUR next to the amount, useful in multi-currency

price_show_from.label: Show “from” prefix
price_show_from.info: On products whose price varies by variant

variant_hide_unavailable.label: Hide unavailable variants
variant_hide_unavailable.info: Otherwise they are struck through and disabled

swatch_map.label: Colour mapping
swatch_map.info: One per line, formatted “Name: #hex”. Names not listed fall back to neutral grey.

predictive_search_enable.label: Enable predictive search
predictive_search_enable.info: Suggests products, collections, pages and articles in the search overlay as shoppers type

video.label: Background video
video.info: If a video is selected, it replaces the image.

show_payment_button.label: Show express payment buttons (Apple Pay, Shop Pay…)
show_payment_button.info: Lets a customer pay in one tap, without creating an account.

content.label: Content
content.info: Fill in with your own terms.

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold (cents)
free_shipping_threshold.info: 10000 = 100.00. Set to 0 to hide the progress bar.

intent.label: Recommendation type
intent.info: Complementary products are the ones you pair by hand in the free Shopify Search & Discovery app. Add this section a second time to show both.

heading.label: Fallback heading
heading.info: Used only when the page has no title

content_width.label: Content width
content_width.info: Maximum width of the text block.

image_position.label: Image position
image_position.info: On mobile, the image always appears above the content.

image.label: Photo
image.info: Optional. Square image recommended, 200 x 200 px minimum.

open_first.label: Open the first question
open_first.info: The first question is expanded when the page loads.

max_width.label: Maximum width
max_width.info: Width of the questions block, in pixels.

answer.label: Answer
answer.info: This answer also feeds the FAQ structured data read by Google.

video.label: Shopify video
video.info: Takes priority over the external video when both are set.

video_url.label: External video URL
video_url.info: YouTube or Vimeo. The third-party player only loads when playback starts.

cover_image.label: Cover image
cover_image.info: Shown before playback. Also used as a fallback visual when no video is set.

autoplay.label: Autoplay, looped and muted
autoplay.info: Automatically disabled for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

grayscale.label: Greyscale logos
grayscale.info: Logos return to full colour on hover.

enable_scroll.label: Continuous scroll
enable_scroll.info: Scrolls the logos in a loop. Requires at least 3 logos. Scrolling pauses on hover and is disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

alt.label: Alt text
alt.info: Brand name, read by screen readers. Leave empty if the logo is purely decorative.

full_width.label: Full width images
full_width.info: The grid spans the full screen width instead of the centered container.

image.label: Image
image.info: Recommended size: 1200 x 1600 px. Set the alt text from the content library.

caption.label: Caption
caption.info: Displayed below the image and visible on every device.

title.label: Custom title
title.info: Leave empty to use the collection title.

image.label: Custom image
image.info: Leave empty to use the collection image.

show_dividers.label: Dividers between columns
show_dividers.info: A thin line separates each column. On mobile it becomes a line between rows.

show_view_all.label: Show "View all" button
show_view_all.info: The button links to the selected blog.

image_ratio.label: Image ratio
image_ratio.info: Has no effect when the round shape is selected.

image_shape.label: Image shape
image_shape.info: The round shape crops the image into a circle and ignores the selected ratio.

image.label: Image
image.info: Optional. Set the alt text from the content library.

link_label.label: Link label
link_label.info: The link only shows when both the label and the URL are filled in.

content_width.label: Content width
content_width.info: Maximum width of the text inside each slide.

autoplay.label: Auto-rotate slides
autoplay.info: Rotation pauses on hover, on keyboard focus and when the tab is hidden. It is turned off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

image_mobile.label: Mobile image
image_mobile.info: Optional. Portrait format recommended, used below 750 px wide.

button_label.label: Button label
button_label.info: Leave empty to hide the button.

text_color.label: Text color
text_color.info: The button and the overlay adapt automatically to stay readable.

overlay_opacity.label: Overlay opacity
overlay_opacity.info: Darkens the image under light text, lightens it under dark text.

target_date.label: End date
target_date.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-24. Uses the store time zone.

target_time.label: End time
target_time.info: 24-hour HH:MM format, for example 23:59. Leave empty for midnight.

button_link.label: Button link
button_link.info: The button only appears when both the label and the link are set.

expired_message.label: Message once expired
expired_message.info: Replaces the timer once the date has passed.

hide_when_expired.label: Hide the section once expired
hide_when_expired.info: The section stays visible in the editor so it can still be edited.

digits_color.label: Digits color
digits_color.info: Also used for the overline. Check the contrast against the background color.

alignment.label: Tab alignment
alignment.info: Position of the tab bar. On mobile, tabs scroll horizontally starting from the left.

active_color.label: Active tab color
active_color.info: Used for the open tab label and its underline. Pick a color dark enough to stay readable on the background.

title.label: Tab title
title.info: Text shown in the tab bar. Short labels work best.

image.label: Image
image.info: Optional. Displayed next to the content, 1200 px wide minimum.

unit.label: Unit of measurement
unit.info: For display only: the unit is shown above the table, values are still typed in manually.

note.label: Table footnote
note.info: Displayed below the table, in small type.

row_heading.label: Size column heading
row_heading.info: First column of the table, the one holding S, M, L…

striped.label: Alternating rows
striped.info: Every other row is lightly tinted to make the table easier to read.

max_width.label: Maximum width
max_width.info: Width of the block, in pixels.

label.label: Row label
label.info: The size name, for example S or 38.

show_average.label: Show average rating
show_average.info: The average is calculated automatically from the ratings entered in the blocks.

star_color.label: Star color
star_color.info: Used for filled stars. Empty stars use a muted version of the text color.

date.label: Date
date.info: Free text, displayed as entered. Example: March 12, 2026.

product.label: Related product
product.info: Optional. Reviews linked to the first selected product feed the aggregate rating structured data read by Google.

verified.label: Verified purchase
verified.info: Displays a badge under the author name.

address.label: Address
address.info: Each line break creates a new address line.

directions_url.label: Directions link
directions_url.info: Paste the directions link generated by your maps application. It opens in a new tab.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.info: Shown on the button and used for the tel: link. International format recommended, for example +33 1 42 71 08 09.

image.label: Map image
image.info: Upload a static image of your map (exported screenshot, hand-drawn plan, illustration). This theme deliberately embeds no third-party map or iframe: no visitor data is sent to an external service on page load, and no API key is required (GDPR choice).

map_url.label: External map link
map_url.info: Link to the maps application of your choice (OpenStreetMap, Maps, Google Maps and so on). The image becomes clickable and opens in a new tab, only if the visitor chooses to.

note.label: Note below the table
note.info: Shown in small type under the table. Leave empty to hide it.

header__2.info: The six row labels, shared by every column. Leave a label empty to hide that row.

highlight_color.label: Highlighted column color
highlight_color.info: Used for the header and background of the highlighted column. Text color adapts automatically to stay readable.

price.label: Price
price.info: Free text, for example "$29" or "On request".

highlight.label: Highlight this column
highlight.info: Adds a "Recommended" badge and applies the highlight color.

header__1.info: Tick what this column includes. The optional detail appears under the check mark.

divider_style.label: Style
divider_style.info: "Empty space" shows no line: only the spacing is applied.

space_above.label: Space above
space_above.info: Spacing is automatically reduced on mobile.

custom_liquid.label: Liquid or HTML code
custom_liquid.info: This code is not validated by the theme. A Liquid or HTML error can break the whole page. Always check the preview before publishing.

width.label: Width
width.info: "Full width" removes the side margins: your code handles its own spacing.
